verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Crossplane lets platform builders define schemas for composite resources and describes its declarative APIs as machine-readable. Nothing documents a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec that a user or agent can fetch. Schema-definition primitives and marketing language about machine-readable APIs are developer building blocks or adjacent claims, not a published downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
